$comment: The art contract. Every sprite the game can draw is listed here with the size it must be, whether the game needs it to ship, and what it is for. tools/art/art.py validates this file and generates client/Assets/Game/ArtCatalog.gen.cs from it; the game loads a sprite by id from Assets/Game/Resources/art/<id>.png and draws a token-coloured placeholder when it is missing. No artwork is listed here yet because none exists: see docs/art.md for the brief and the rules (no AI-generated art ships).

palette.note: Roles, not hex. The renderer tints and the art must sit inside this palette; replica/design/tokens.json is the source of truth.

rules.no_text: Art must not contain baked Persian text: it cannot be translated, scaled or read by accessibility.
rules.no_ai: AI-generated imagery is a concept reference only and is never shipped (replica/design/concepts/).

assets.description: The turquoise stone: a ridged firouzeh cabochon with a thin gold bezel. The silhouette must stay readable at 48 px.
assets.brief: One accent, one ridge highlight, no gloss beyond one specular dot. Five pieces must be distinguishable in greyscale by silhouette alone.

assets.description: Lapis lazuli: a deep blue hexagonal tile with a carved edge.
assets.brief: Deepest value of the five. Silhouette: hexagon.

assets.description: Carnelian: a warm red-orange drop with banded striations.
assets.brief: Warmest value. Silhouette: teardrop.

assets.description: Emerald: a green octagon with a faceted centre.
assets.brief: Silhouette: octagon; must not read as the turquoise at small sizes.

assets.description: Pearl: an ivory circle with a soft rim and a single highlight.
assets.brief: Lightest value; the one piece that must survive on a light panel.

assets.description: Dynamite on a piece: the L/T match reward.
assets.brief: Must read as a different object on top of any of the five pieces.

assets.description: Spinner: the square-match reward.
assets.brief: Rotational symmetry; a separate FX layer spins it.

assets.description: Electro ball: the five-in-a-line reward.
assets.brief: Bright core, no bloom baked in.

assets.description: Horizontal rocket: the four-in-a-row reward.
assets.brief: Direction is part of the silhouette, not a colour.

assets.description: Vertical rocket: the four-in-a-column reward.
assets.brief: Same object as powerup_rocket_row, rotated 90° — draw once, ship twice if that is cheaper.

assets.description: Wooden crate, one layer.
assets.brief: Damage state is a tint/scale in code; a second sprite is optional.

assets.description: Frost on a piece, up to three layers.
assets.brief: Semi-transparent; the piece underneath must stay readable.

assets.description: Ivy binding a piece.
assets.brief: Thin, no cast shadow, so it never hides the piece colour.

assets.description: Potion vial: a goal object.
assets.brief: Matches the potion icon in the HUD.

assets.description: Samovar: the Persian-flavoured obstacle.
assets.brief: Silhouette first: spout, tap, lid. Reads at 48 px.

assets.description: Flower pot: a goal object.
assets.brief: Two colours maximum.

assets.description: Chain locking a piece until its neighbours are cleared.
assets.brief: Draw the links, not a bar.

assets.description: Wax seal: the royal lock used in the harder levels.
assets.brief: Gold on deep red; the one obstacle allowed to look expensive.

assets.description: Coin icon for the top bar.
assets.brief: Flat gold, no outline; it sits on a dark pill.

assets.description: Potion icon for the top bar.
assets.brief: Firouzeh liquid, ivory glass.

assets.description: Heart/life icon.
assets.brief: Must survive both states: full and empty (empty is a tint in code).

assets.description: Level-clear star, used by the result overlay.
assets.brief: Three sizes come from one sprite; do not bake a glow.

assets.description: The palace illustration behind the home hub: a courtyard wall and a tiled gate at dusk. 4:3, cropped by the canvas.
assets.brief: Composed for a right-to-left layout: the visual weight sits right and leaves the left third calm for the level card. Persian-royal, not Disney: muqarnas, turquoise tile, brick, no characters.

assets.description: Firouzeh Square before it is built: an empty plaza with a dry pool.
assets.brief: Built and unbuilt must share one camera and one light, so the change reads as progress.

assets.description: Lapis Garden before it is built: bare earth, one cypress stump, a broken canal.
assets.brief: Same camera and light as d1.

assets.description: The Prince's Gate: a half-finished arch with scaffolding.
assets.brief: Same camera and light; the arch is the chapter's payoff shot.

assets.description: Task prop: the fountain pool of Firouzeh Square.
assets.brief: One object per task, drawn to sit on the district plate.

assets.description: Task prop: the tiled wall.
assets.brief: Tile pattern must be drawn, not a texture photo.

assets.description: Task prop: the entrance portico.
assets.brief: Reads as an archway from the district camera distance.

assets.description: Task prop: the bazaar stalls.
assets.brief: Three stalls, one colour family.

assets.description: Task prop: the garden canal.
assets.brief: Water is flat colour plus one line, no realism.

assets.description: Task prop: the cypress row.
assets.brief: Silhouette-first; the cypress is the chapter's signature shape.

assets.description: Task prop: the garden pavilion.
assets.brief: Chahar-taq: four arches, one dome.

assets.description: Task prop: the garden fountain.
assets.brief: Water again flat; the shape does the work.

assets.description: Task prop: the gate arch.
assets.brief: Full muqarnas suggested with three bands, not modelled.

assets.description: Task prop: the gate doors.
assets.brief: Closed in the unbuilt plate, open in the built one — draw both or make it a cut-out.

assets.description: Task prop: the naqqareh (kettledrum) platform.
assets.brief: The one prop allowed a figural element: drums, no people.

assets.description: Task prop: the prince's banner.
assets.brief: No readable text on the banner. Emblem only.

assets.description: The district chest, closed and open.
assets.brief: Two sprites (closed/open) or one cut-out; gold fittings, wood body.

assets.description: Nine-slice frame for cards. Border 24 px.
assets.brief: Borders must tile without a seam at any size.

assets.description: Nine-slice face for the primary button. Border 24 px.
assets.brief: Flat firouzeh enamel with a 2 px inner highlight; no gradient banding.

assets.description: Nine-slice frame around the board. Border 28 px, which is what ArtLibrary.GetSliced is called with. Its middle is a window, not a fill: the chapter's floor is drawn behind the board and a tray would hide it.
assets.brief: A dark lapis band with one gold keyline and a bevel on the window's inner edge; the band is 0.092 of the sprite so it stays inside the nine-slice border. Must not compete with the pieces.

assets.description: Store and launcher icon: the palace gate in a gold ring.
assets.brief: Reads at 48 px. No text. Must not resemble Royal Kingdom's icon in composition or colour balance (replica-brand/sweep.py checks the sweep, a human checks this).

assets.description: Two opposing arrows: the icon for the move counter, and the one gesture the whole game is played with.
assets.brief: Must read at 22 px beside a number. Two colours, chunky shafts, no thin strokes and no letterforms.

assets.description: The win plaque: a lapis banner with a gold keyline, rosettes at both ends and a warm light behind it.
assets.brief: The middle two thirds stay quiet — the title, the stars and the reward are drawn over it in code.

assets.description: The same plaque after a loss: steel and silver instead of lapis and gold, a crescent at one end and three dim stars.
assets.brief: Quiet, not punishing. No red, no broken glass, no skulls — the retry button does the work.

assets.description: A speaker with one wave: the sound-effects switch. Firouzeh, because it is a channel, not a reward.
assets.brief: Reads as a speaker at 22 px. One wave only; two turns into a smudge.

assets.description: A single eighth note in ivory: the music switch.
assets.brief: Distinguishable from icon_sound at 22 px by silhouette alone — one solid blob at the bottom left, no cone.

assets.description: A phone with a ring either side: the haptics switch.
assets.brief: The phone is a solid slab, the rings are open; no lettering on the screen.

assets.description: A bell in gold: the notifications switch, and the only icon allowed to look like an invitation.
assets.brief: One clapper, one shoulder. No badge, no exclamation mark.

assets.description: Three sliders with turquoise knobs: the settings entry point.
assets.brief: Survives 22 px, where a cog would be a smudge. Knobs at three different positions so it reads as sliders.

assets.description: The in-level mallet: a lapis badge with a gold rim and a wooden mallet, for clearing one tile.
assets.brief: Tool inside the disc at 0.62 of its radius. The five boosters must be told apart at 56 dp by tool silhouette alone.

assets.description: The in-level ram: a beam with a stone head, for clearing a whole row.
assets.brief: Horizontal on purpose — the auger is the vertical one, and the pair must not need a label.

assets.description: The in-level auger: a T-handle drill, for clearing a whole column.
assets.brief: Vertical, pointing down. Same badge as the rest of the set.

assets.description: The in-level whirlwind: a spiral, for reshuffling the board.
assets.brief: A spiral only — no arrows, no tiles, nothing that could be read as a direction.

assets.description: The in-level falcon: a bird over three sparks, for three small blasts.
assets.brief: The three sparks are the meaning; the bird is the character. Keep the sparks out of the wings.

assets.description: A finished level on the world map: a gold medallion with an ivory star.
assets.brief: Must read at 24 px on a dark map. Star, not a number: numbers are drawn in code.

assets.description: The next level to play: a firouzeh medallion with a gold rim and two ivory chevrons.
assets.brief: The only node allowed a glow, because it is the only one that is a call to action.

assets.description: A level that is not unlocked yet: a dark disc with a padlock.
assets.brief: Low contrast on purpose, but the padlock silhouette must still be legible at 24 px.

assets.description: The frame for one task in a district list: a lapis card with a firouzeh stripe on its right edge.
assets.brief: Nine-slice with a 24 px border; the stripe lives inside the border so it never stretches. Flat middle: the middle holds type.

assets.description: The reward chest, open: lid back, warm light out of the box, coins over the lip.
assets.brief: Same camera, same wood and bands as reward_chest — the two must read as one object in two states.

assets.description: The chapter-1 gate with its doors swung back and light coming through: the finished state of the gate task.
assets.brief: Doors read as thin wedges in perspective, not as open rectangles.

assets.description: The chapter-1 gate half built: a stone arch, scaffolding and half a wall.
assets.brief: Three states must be distinguishable at 96 px: closed (prop_ch01_gate), building (this), open (prop_ch01_gate_open).

assets.description: Firouzeh Square restored: lit niches, hanging lamps, warm pools on the paving.
assets.brief: Same camera, horizon, wall and palette as district_ch01_d1 — only the light changes.

assets.description: The bazaar street restored: lit niches, hanging lamps, warm pools.
assets.brief: Pairs with district_ch01_d2 and must line up with it pixel for pixel at the horizon.

assets.description: The canal quarter restored: lit niches, hanging lamps, warm pools.
assets.brief: Pairs with district_ch01_d3, as the other two do.

assets.description: The world map plate: hills at dusk, the palace on the skyline as a silhouette, and one road running up to its gate.
assets.brief: Deliberately dark and low contrast: the level nodes and their stars are drawn on top and must win. No text, no numbers, no labels.

assets.description: The onboarding hand: an ivory hand with the index finger out and a gold cuff.
assets.brief: Points to the upper left in art space; the view rotates it. No skin texture, no fingernails at this size.

assets.description: The tap ripple: two thin rings and a dot, drawn to be scaled up and faded by code.
assets.brief: Transparent outside the rings so it can sit over a piece without hiding it.

assets.description: The clear spark: a four-point star of light, used when a piece is taken off the board.
assets.brief: Must read at 16 px. No baked rotation: the view spins it.

assets.description: The burst ring: a soft-edged circle of light for a power-up going off.
assets.brief: Soft on both edges so it can be scaled without banding.

assets.description: The electro ball, charged: the same bolt inside one bright ring and a firouzeh arc.
assets.brief: Must be tellable from powerup_electro at cell size: the ring is the difference, not the bolt.

assets.description: The empty cell of the board: a quiet square of stone under every piece.
assets.brief: Darker than any piece and never above 30 alpha of gold, so it never reads as content.

assets.description: The floor the board sits on in chapter one: a lapis field lit from the middle under a shamse medallion, drawn behind the board frame.
assets.brief: Scaled to the camera and cropped, so no frame and no border - the centre is the light and the edges fall to near black. Every line below 45 alpha of gold: a floor that reads as content steals the silhouette of the piece standing on it.

assets.description: The chest payoff: three coins and a scatter of sparks.
assets.brief: Fits inside the letterbox of a 128 tile box; reads at 40 px.

assets.description: Home: the palace with the district rebuilt — lamps lit, iwan full of light, the pool reflecting it.
assets.brief: Same geometry as home_palace, one overlay pass of warm light; the two plates are the same building.

assets.description: Back chevron, pointing right because the interface runs right to left.
assets.brief: Solid ivory with a dark hairline so it holds on the night sky and on panels.

assets.description: Dismiss: a two-stroke cross.
assets.brief: Equal arms, 45 degrees, 6 percent stroke; no circle around it.

assets.description: Confirmation tick, green.
assets.brief: Two strokes with a rounded weight; reads at 24 px.

assets.description: Rank: the kingdom level crown, gold with a red bead.
assets.brief: Three points and a band; the band keeps it from reading as a flame.

assets.description: The Play Store feature graphic: the lit palace on the night sky, no text.
assets.brief: Store listings set their own title over it, so the left third stays quiet.

assets.description: Charged dynamite: the same bundle, inside the gold collar.
assets.brief: The 3x3 blast. Reads as the plain bundle, smaller, so the pair is never confused.

assets.description: Charged horizontal rocket: the same shell, inside the gold collar.
assets.brief: Clears a row and the row above it; the collar is what says so at 40 px.

assets.description: Charged vertical rocket: the same shell turned, inside the gold collar.
assets.brief: Clears a column and the column beside it.

assets.description: Charged spinner: the same two arcs, inside the gold collar.
assets.brief: Reshuffles the board and keeps the power-ups in place.
